select case when uc.user_prtc_no is null then null else fmsown.fn_decrypt(uc.user_prtc_no, #{encryptKey}) end as userPrctId from fmsown.tb_scm_user u inner join tb_scm_user_subco p on u.user_id = p.user_id inner join tb_scm_user_subco_prtc uc on p.mbl_tel_user_prtc_sn = uc.user_prtc_sn where u.user_id = #{userId} and u.user_clsf_cd = 'SUB' limit 1
